name: Thermospheric density calibration (JB2008 temperature corrections)
description: JB2008 thermospheric mass density at points (propagator/hpop's JB2008, driven by SET SOLFSMY/DTCFILE rows as hpop reads them) with an exospheric-temperature correction added to JB2008's DSTDTC: spherical harmonics in latitude and local solar time per time bin, or values at time nodes, optionally linear in altitude. Estimates the correction from observed densities (Gauss-Newton on log-density residuals per bin) or from the orbital decay of catalogued objects (element-set histories propagated by Vallado SGP4; Gauss-Newton on the sets' mean semi-major axes with each object's ballistic coefficient): public, simplified analogues of the Dynamic Calibration of the Atmosphere in HASDM; the orbital energy of states in Earth-fixed axes (the Jacobi integral of the EGM2008 geopotential, with its gradient) and the work done by JB2008 drag along them. Typed contracts 1.0: every method takes one SDS $DCL (Density Calibration) record and answers with one $DCL: the model in ATMOSPHERE ($ATM JB08 or NRLMSIS00E), the JB2008 drivers as $PRW PRWJB2008IndicesTable rows or NRLMSISE-00's daily $SPW rows, element-set histories as $OMM, states as an $OEM ephemeris block, times in Unix milliseconds (UTC).

sequentialJustification.detail: Deterministic density evaluation, SGP4 propagation and least squares over caller-supplied points, element sets, drivers and observations. No host calls, threads or network access.

methods.displayName: Evaluate JB2008 with a temperature correction

acceptedTypeSets.description: POINTS (TIME_MS, LATITUDE_DEG, LONGITUDE_DEG, ALTITUDE_KM; or with SUN_RIGHT_ASCENSION_DEG, SUN_DECLINATION_DEG and MODEL_DRIVERS, the arguments of SET's JB2008 subroutine), ATMOSPHERE with its drivers (JB2008_DRIVERS or SPACE_WEATHER), CORRECTION (Harmonic or Nodes; JB2008 only), SETTINGS WANT_DERIVATIVE and WANT_SUN_DIAGNOSTICS.
PRODUCT DensityEvaluation: POINTS with DENSITY_KG_M3 (NaN = refused), DELTA_T_K, LOCAL_SOLAR_TIME_H, DLN_DENSITY_DT_PER_K and SUN_LONGITUDE/LATITUDE_DEG when asked, REFUSED.

methods.displayName: Estimate temperature corrections from observed densities

acceptedTypeSets.description: POINTS with OBSERVED_DENSITY_KG_M3 (and WEIGHT), JB2008_DRIVERS (or MODEL_DRIVERS), SETTINGS FROM_MS, TO_MS, DEGREE, BIN_S, LOG_DENSITY_SIGMA, PRIOR_SIGMA_K, MIN_POINTS, MAX_ITERATIONS, EDIT_SIGMA (< 0: no editing).
PRODUCT DensityCalibration: CORRECTION Harmonic, one segment per bin with COEFFICIENTS_K, SIGMAS_K and its FIT; SETTINGS as applied.

methods.displayName: Orbital decay of element sets under JB2008

acceptedTypeSets.description: JB2008_DRIVERS, OBJECTS [{ID, ELEMENT_SETS ($OMM: EPOCH, MEAN_MOTION, ECCENTRICITY, INCLINATION, RA_OF_ASC_NODE, ARG_OF_PERICENTER, MEAN_ANOMALY, BSTAR), BALLISTIC_COEFFICIENT_M2_KG, SPAN_S}], CORRECTION (Nodes), SETTINGS STEP_S, MAX_GAP_S, WANT_SAMPLES.
PRODUCT OrbitalDecay: per object the sets' mean semi-major axes, perigee heights, cumulative drag decay, per segment the decay and mean altitude, and SAMPLE_* when asked.

methods.displayName: Estimate temperature corrections and ballistic coefficients from element-set histories

acceptedTypeSets.description: JB2008_DRIVERS, OBJECTS [{ID, ELEMENT_SETS ($OMM), LN_B_PRIOR_MEAN, LN_B_PRIOR_SIGMA}], SETTINGS FROM_MS, TO_MS, NODE_STEP_S, NODE_ALTITUDES_KM, RANDOM_WALK_K_PER_SQRT_DAY, MEAN_LEVEL_K, ALTITUDE_DIFFERENCE_K, STEP_S, MAX_GAP_S, RESIDUAL_FLOOR_M, EDIT_SIGMA, MAX_ITERATIONS, REWEIGHT_ITERATIONS, TOLERANCE_K/LN_B/OFFSET_M, MIN_SETS, WANT_RESIDUALS.

PRODUCT DecayCalibration: CORRECTION Nodes (values and sigmas), per object ln B, its sigma, B, residual scale and fit, skipped objects with SKIPPED_REASON, FIT, LEVELS, HISTORY, LEVEL_LN_B_CORRELATION, MEAN_LEVEL_SIGMA_K.

outputPorts.description: The node correction and ballistic coefficients ($DCL).

methods.displayName: Specific orbital energy in Earth-fixed axes (EGM2008 Jacobi integral)

acceptedTypeSets.description: STATES (EPHEMERIS: an $OEM ephemeris block, GCRF km and km/s; DUT1_S, POLAR_MOTION_X/Y_ARCSEC), GRAVITY_DEGREE (2-70; 0 = 36), GRAVITY_ORDER (0 = the degree), GM_M3_S2, EARTH_ROTATION_RAD_S, SETTINGS WANT_GRADIENT.
PRODUCT OrbitalEnergy: STATES ENERGY_J_KG, KINETIC/POTENTIAL/ROTATIONAL_J_KG, RELATIVE_SPEED_M_S, the WGS84 geodetic point, ENERGY_GRADIENT when asked, REFUSED.

methods.displayName: Drag power and work along states (JB2008 with a temperature correction)

acceptedTypeSets.description: STATES (EPHEMERIS), ATMOSPHERE with its drivers, CORRECTION (JB2008 only), BALLISTIC_COEFFICIENT_M2_KG, EARTH_ROTATION_RAD_S.
PRODUCT DragWork: STATES DENSITY_KG_M3, RELATIVE_SPEED_M_S, DRAG_POWER_W_KG, DRAG_WORK_J_KG, CUMULATIVE_DRAG_WORK_J_KG, REFUSED.

outputPorts.description: Drag power and work per state ($DCL).
